comparison.objective: Rotate four sparkling-wine bottles in place within a pupitre.
comparison.physical_skill: Grip and turn bottles about slanted axes by a visually measured angle without extracting them.
comparison.success_condition: Each bottle rotates 30–60 degrees while remaining seated; any substantial extraction invalidates all credit.
comparison.reason: Tests constrained in-place rotation and visual angle control, with no tooling, fracture, or debris recovery.
